title: Embedded finite-coefficient lattices on normal schemes
statement: Fix ell prime. Let X be a nonempty connected locally Noetherian quasi-compact scheme with every local ring an integrally closed domain [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring]. For every finite intermediate field E of the fixed p-adic algebraic closure and every lisse module L over the continuous condensed E coefficient ring, HasLattice ell E X L of [def-sfb-lisse-representation-data] holds. In particular the lattice is embedded, lisse and integral, and its adjoint under the recorded extension/restriction adjunction is an isomorphism. No separatedness or invertibility of ell is assumed.

proof.text: Assume now that $X$ is normal. For any lisse $E_X$-module $L$, [lem-sfb-embedded-lattice-coefficient-comparison] identifies embedded integral lattices with continuous-coefficient lattice pairs. By [lem-weil-pbc-lisse-lattice-class-sheaf] their classes give a locally constant, locally nonempty sheaf $F$ of sets on $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$. The normal, connected, nonempty Noetherian $X$ satisfies every hypothesis of [lem-a1-normal-locally-constant-finite-section], so there is a finite etale surjection $p:Y\to X$ with $F(Y)$ nonempty. The lattice-class node then supplies an actual lattice pair on $Y$. The underlying space of $X$ is Noetherian by step 1; [lem-weil-pbc-lisse-lattice-finite-etale-descent] gives an integral locally free model on $X$. Its scalar isomorphism embeds it as a lattice by [lem-sfb-embedded-lattice-coefficient-comparison]. This proves (4) for $E$, without imposing separatedness, a characteristic hypothesis, or invertibility of $\ell$.

proof.text: The Noetherian-space hypothesis in finite-etale lattice descent follows from local Noetherianity and quasi-compactness. Transport the resulting pair back along the coefficient comparisons; by the embedded-lattice comparison its inclusion is mono and its scalar-extension adjoint is invertible. This is exactly HasLattice, including rank zero.

theorem has_lattice_of_normal
    (ell : ℕ) [Fact ell.Prime]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [Nonempty X] [ConnectedSpace X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [CompactSpace X]
    (hnormal : ∀ z : X, IsDomain (X.presheaf.stalk z) ∧
      IsIntegrallyClosed (X.presheaf.stalk z))
    (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ell)
    (L : Modules (Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E)) X)
    (hL : IsLisseCoefficientModule (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) L) :
    HasLattice ell E X L
